description: Decide where to persist anything meant for future agent sessions, in any project. Use before saving a rule, preference, correction, workflow or fact about Pablo so agents won't need to ask or be told again ("remember this", "store this", "make sure this doesn't happen again"), and before adding or changing agent-facing guidance in any instruction file, skill, hook, context or reference doc, project map, brief or note. Not for ordinary code, human-facing docs, or session logs.
